title: Food Offered to Idols

questions.question: Now concerning food offered to idols: we know that "all of us possess knowledge." This "knowledge" puffs up, but love ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 8:1 (ESV): "Now concerning food offered to idols: we know that 'all of us possess knowledge.' This 'knowledge' puffs up, but love builds up."

questions.question: If anyone imagines that he knows something, he does not yet know as he ____ to know.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 8:2 (ESV): "If anyone imagines that he knows something, he does not yet know as he ought to know."

questions.question: But if anyone loves God, he is ____ by God.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 8:3 (ESV): "But if anyone loves God, he is known by God."

questions.question: Therefore, as to the eating of food offered to idols, we know that "an idol has no real existence," and that "there is no God but ____."
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 8:4 (ESV): "Therefore, as to the eating of food offered to idols, we know that 'an idol has no real existence,' and that 'there is no God but one.'"

questions.question: For although there may be so-called gods in heaven or on earth... yet for us there is one God, the Father, from whom are all things and for whom we exist, and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things and ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 8:5-6 (ESV): "yet for us there is one God, the Father, from whom are all things and for whom we exist, and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things and through whom we exist."

questions.question: However, not all possess this knowledge. But some, through former association with idols, eat food as really offered to an idol, and their ____, being weak, is defiled.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 8:7 (ESV): "However, not all possess this knowledge. But some, through former association with idols, eat food as really offered to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled."

questions.question: Food will not commend us to God. We are no worse off if we do not eat, and no ____ if we do.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 8:8 (ESV): "Food will not commend us to God. We are no worse off if we do not eat, and no better off if we do."

questions.question: But take care that this right of yours does not somehow become a ____ to the weak.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 8:9 (ESV): "But take care that this right of yours does not somehow become a stumbling block to the weak."

questions.question: For if anyone sees you who have knowledge eating in an idol's temple, will he not be encouraged, if his conscience is weak, to do what?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 8:10 (ESV): "For if anyone sees you who have knowledge eating in an idol's temple, will he not be encouraged, if his conscience is weak, to eat food offered to idols?"

questions.question: And so by your knowledge this weak person is destroyed, the brother for whom ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 8:11 (ESV): "And so by your knowledge this weak person is destroyed, the brother for whom Christ died."

questions.question: Thus, sinning against your brothers and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 8:12 (ESV): "Thus, sinning against your brothers and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ."

questions.question: Therefore, if food makes my brother stumble, I will ____, lest I make my brother stumble.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 8:13 (ESV): "Therefore, if food makes my brother stumble, I will never eat meat, lest I make my brother stumble."

questions.question: What principle does Paul contrast with "knowledge" at the beginning of chapter 8, showing what is truly needed in the church community?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 8:1 (ESV): "This 'knowledge' puffs up, but love builds up." Love is the guiding principle for not using one's freedom to harm a brother.

questions.question: What is the danger of a weak conscience being "encouraged" to eat food offered to idols against their own convictions?
options: They are participating in what they believe is sin, defiling their conscience
They may become physically sick from the meat
They will be expelled from the Jewish community
They might join the pagan priesthood
questions.correctAnswer: They are participating in what they believe is sin, defiling their conscience
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 8:7 (ESV): "...their conscience, being weak, is defiled." Actions against one's conscience are spiritual harm even if the act itself (eating the meat) is morally neutral.

questions.question: Paul affirms what profound truth regarding the Father and Jesus Christ in verse 6?
options: The Father is the source of all things, and Jesus Christ is the agent through whom all things come
Both are completely indistinguishable from the other
The Father rules heaven, and Jesus rules the earth
The Father loves the world, but Jesus judges it
questions.correctAnswer: The Father is the source of all things, and Jesus Christ is the agent through whom all things come
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 8:6 (ESV): "yet for us there is one God, the Father, from whom are all things and for whom we exist, and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things and through whom we exist."

key_verse_text: Therefore, if food makes my brother stumble, I will never eat meat, lest I make my brother stumble.
